meta.name: discovery-interview-prep
meta.description: Plan customer discovery interviews with the right goal, segment, constraints, and method. Use when preparing interviews for problem validation, churn research, or new product ideas.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划客户发现访谈的目标、人群与方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备客户访谈来验证问题或探索新想法
copy.tagline_en: Plan customer discovery interviews with goals, segments, and methods
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing customer interviews to validate problems or explore new ideas

howto.what: 引导你完成客户发现访谈的规划，通过提问确定研究目标、客户群体、约束条件和方法，最终输出一份包含访谈框架、问题示例和应避免偏见的定制计划。
howto.when: 当你需要准备客户发现访谈时触发，例如验证问题、调查流失原因或探索新产品创意。

say.text: 帮我规划5个企业客户的流失原因访谈，2周内完成。
say.note: 技能将根据你的目标、客户群体和约束条件生成访谈计划。

say.text: 我想验证一个新产品的想法，但只能做冷启动招募。
say.note: 技能会推荐适合的方法论并生成问题框架。

howto.what_en: Guides you through planning customer discovery interviews by asking about research goals, customer segments, constraints, and methodology, then outputs a tailored interview plan with framework, sample questions, and biases to avoid.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to prepare customer discovery interviews, such as for problem validation, churn research, or new product ideas.

say_en.text: Plan 5 enterprise churn interviews within 2 weeks.
I want to validate a new product idea with cold outreach only.
say_en.note: The skill will recommend a methodology and generate a question framework.
